name: girigirilove Glass C

localizedDescriptions.zh: GiriGiri 动漫浏览器：支持分类搜索、双来源新番时间表、系统播放、逐集离线、收藏、历史与续播，并提供 Bangumi OAuth、完整条目资料、系统翻译和进度同步。
localizedDescriptions.en: GiriGiri anime browser with category search, GiriGiri and Bangumi schedules, system playback, per-episode offline saving, favorites, history and resume, plus Bangumi OAuth, full subject details, system translation and progress sync.
